dictation.text: I usually get up at seven o'clock.
dictation.uk: Я зазвичай встаю о сьомій.

dictation.text: Can I have a cup of tea, please?
dictation.uk: Можна мені чашку чаю?

dictation.text: We went to the cinema last night.
dictation.uk: Учора ввечері ми ходили в кіно.

dictation.text: My sister lives in a small town near the sea.
dictation.uk: Моя сестра живе в маленькому містечку біля моря.

dictation.text: How much are these shoes?
dictation.uk: Скільки коштують ці черевики?

dictation.text: It's very cold today, so take a warm jacket.
dictation.uk: Сьогодні дуже холодно, тож візьми теплу куртку.

dictation.text: The train to Warsaw leaves at half past nine.
dictation.uk: Потяг до Варшави відходить о пів на десяту.

dictation.text: I don't like coffee, but I love chocolate.
dictation.uk: Я не люблю каву, але обожнюю шоколад.

dictation.text: Where is the nearest supermarket?
dictation.uk: Де найближчий супермаркет?

dictation.text: We are going to visit our friends on Sunday.
dictation.uk: У неділю ми збираємося в гості до друзів.

dictation.text: She has got two brothers and a sister.
dictation.uk: У неї два брати й сестра.

dictation.text: Could you open the window, please?
dictation.uk: Чи не могли б ви відчинити вікно?

dictation.text: I've never been to London.
dictation.uk: Я ніколи не був у Лондоні.

dictation.text: Turn left at the traffic lights.
dictation.uk: На світлофорі поверніть ліворуч.

dictation.text: What time does the museum close?
dictation.uk: О котрій зачиняється музей?

dictation.text: I've been learning English for about two years.
dictation.uk: Я вчу англійську близько двох років.

dictation.text: If it rains tomorrow, we'll stay at home and watch a film.
dictation.uk: Якщо завтра буде дощ, ми залишимося вдома і подивимося фільм.

dictation.text: Sorry I'm late, the bus didn't come for twenty minutes.
dictation.uk: Вибач за запізнення, автобуса не було двадцять хвилин.

dictation.text: Would you mind waiting here for a few minutes?
dictation.uk: Не заперечуєте почекати тут кілька хвилин?

dictation.text: The restaurant was so busy that we couldn't get a table.
dictation.uk: У ресторані було так людно, що ми не змогли знайти столик.

dictation.text: I was cooking dinner when my phone suddenly rang.
dictation.uk: Я готував вечерю, коли раптом задзвонив телефон.

dictation.text: We're thinking of moving to a bigger flat next year.
dictation.uk: Ми думаємо переїхати в більшу квартиру наступного року.

dictation.text: You should have told me earlier, I could have helped.
dictation.uk: Треба було сказати раніше, я міг би допомогти.

dictation.text: The flight was delayed because of the bad weather.
dictation.uk: Рейс затримали через погану погоду.

dictation.text: Have you decided where to go on holiday this summer?
dictation.uk: Ви вже вирішили, куди поїдете у відпустку цього літа?

dictation.text: I'm not used to driving on the left side of the road.
dictation.uk: Я не звик їздити по лівому боці дороги.

dictation.text: She asked me if I could recommend a good dentist.
dictation.uk: Вона запитала, чи можу я порадити хорошого стоматолога.

dictation.text: It's the best pizza I've ever had in my life.
dictation.uk: Це найкраща піца, яку я коли-небудь їв.

dictation.text: Don't forget to take your passport and your boarding pass.
dictation.uk: Не забудь узяти паспорт і посадковий талон.

dictation.text: Although it was expensive, the hotel was worth every penny.
dictation.uk: Хоча готель був дорогий, він вартував кожної копійки.

dictation.text: If I had known about the traffic, I would have left much earlier.
dictation.uk: Якби я знав про затори, вийшов би значно раніше.

dictation.text: By the time we got to the station, the last train had already left.
dictation.uk: Поки ми дісталися вокзалу, останній потяг уже поїхав.

dictation.text: I wish I had more time to read, but work keeps me really busy.
dictation.uk: Хотів би я мати більше часу на читання, але робота мене дуже займає.

dictation.text: Despite the rain, thousands of people turned up for the concert.
dictation.uk: Попри дощ, на концерт прийшли тисячі людей.

dictation.text: The new bridge is expected to be finished by the end of next year.
dictation.uk: Новий міст очікують завершити до кінця наступного року.

dictation.text: She must have forgotten about our meeting, because she never showed up.
dictation.uk: Вона, мабуть, забула про зустріч, бо так і не прийшла.

dictation.text: Could you tell me how long it takes to get to the city centre?
dictation.uk: Підкажіть, скільки часу добиратися до центру міста?

dictation.text: We'll have been living here for five years next month.
dictation.uk: Наступного місяця буде п'ять років, як ми тут живемо.

dictation.text: The more you practise speaking, the more confident you'll become.
dictation.uk: Чим більше ти практикуєш мовлення, тим впевненішим ставатимеш.

dictation.text: I'd rather we stayed in tonight, if you don't mind.
dictation.uk: Я б волів, щоб ми сьогодні залишилися вдома, якщо ти не проти.

dictation.text: He's been working so hard lately that he hardly ever sees his family.
dictation.uk: Останнім часом він так багато працює, що майже не бачить родину.

dictation.text: Not only did they cancel the flight, but they also lost our luggage.
dictation.uk: Вони не лише скасували рейс, а й загубили наш багаж.

dictation.text: It's high time we started thinking about our plans for the summer.
dictation.uk: Давно пора почати думати про плани на літо.

dictation.text: Had I known you were coming, I would have cooked something special.
dictation.uk: Якби я знав, що ти прийдеш, приготував би щось особливе.

dictation.text: Taking everything into account, I think we made the right decision.
dictation.uk: Зваживши все, я думаю, ми ухвалили правильне рішення.

lines.text: Hi there! What can I get you?
Hi! Can I have a large cappuccino, please?
Sure. Would you like it with regular milk or oat milk?
Oat milk, please. And do you have anything without sugar to eat?
We've got a cheese sandwich or a banana muffin. The muffin has no added sugar.
I'll take the sandwich, please. Is it possible to heat it up?
Of course. Is that for here or to go?
For here, please. I'll sit by the window.
Great. That's eight pounds fifty. You can pay by card over there.
Perfect. Thanks a lot!
You're welcome. I'll bring it to your table in a few minutes.

lines.text: So, any plans for the weekend?
Not really. Vita wants to go to the mountains, but the forecast says it's going to rain.
Oh, that's a shame. Have you been to the new science museum? It opened last month.
No, I haven't. Is it any good?
It's brilliant. We went with the kids last Saturday and stayed for four hours. There's a whole floor about space.
Sounds great. Do you need to book tickets in advance?
I'd recommend it. At the weekend it gets really busy, and we had to queue for half an hour.
OK, I'll check the website tonight. If the weather's bad, that could be a perfect plan B.
And there's a nice Italian place just around the corner, if you get hungry afterwards.
Thanks for the tip! I might actually take Vita there for dinner.

lines.text: Excuse me, my flight to Lisbon has been delayed by three hours. I've got a connection in Frankfurt.
Let me have a look. Can I see your boarding pass, please?
Here you are.
I'm afraid you'll miss your connecting flight. But I can rebook you on a direct flight to Lisbon that leaves at six fifteen this evening.
A direct flight? That would be even better. What about my suitcase?
Don't worry, we'll transfer it automatically. It will be on the same plane as you.
Great. And is there anything I can do while I wait? I have about five hours.
Here's a voucher for fifteen euros. You can use it in any café or restaurant in the terminal.
Thank you. Am I also entitled to any compensation?
You can apply online. Just fill in the form on our website and attach your booking number.

lines.text: So this is the living room. As you can see, it gets a lot of light in the afternoon.
It's lovely. How much is the rent, exactly?
It's two thousand eight hundred a month, plus utilities, which usually come to about four hundred in winter.
I see. And how much would the deposit be?
One month's rent. You'd get it back at the end, provided there's no damage, of course.
That sounds fair. We're expecting a baby next spring, so we'd like to stay at least two years. Would that be possible?
Congratulations! Yes, I'd actually prefer a long-term contract. The first one would be for a year, and then we can extend it.
And would you mind if we painted the second bedroom? It would become the nursery.
Not at all, as long as you choose a light colour. Just let me know before you start.
Great. We'll talk it over tonight and get back to you by tomorrow afternoon.

questions.q: How much are the utilities in winter?
When will the deposit be returned?
options: At the end, if there is no damage
